collection.title: VW Polo 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW Polo 2021 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Polo which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.

image.alt: VW Polo 2021 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
